designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1999 to protect and restore coastal wetlands and spring-fed streams for coaster brook trout on Lake Superior's Chequamegon Bay.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Whittlesey Creek National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
FWS, Whittlesey Creek NWR hunting and fishing regulations: "The refuge was established in 1999 in an effort to restore coaster brook trout"

review.note: Year confirmed only by another FWS publication; weak sourcing.
